quote: Caporaso, Harris, and Mazur posed the uniform boundedness conjecture in their 1997 paper 'Uniformity of rational points' in the Journal of the American Mathematical Society
posed_by: Lucia Caporaso, Joe Harris, and Barry Mazur
note: The conjecture emerged from earlier foundational work by Faltings (1983), Lang (1971+), and Bombieri (1980), but the specific formulation asking for uniform boundedness dependent only on K and g was posed by Caporaso, Harris, and Mazur in 1997.
